eligibility.dailyUniverse: prior audited code/session ledger only; no master attribute predictor; codes are join keys, not stable identity claims
eligibility.extremaNote: conservative fixed minimum-tick tolerance, not inferred historical tick table
eligibility.unknownMissing: retained; no zero-fill; complete observed5m blocks only; pattern failures require full future response window, otherwise null

registry.humanSemantics: NOT_APPLICABLE unless independent reviewer; no VLM feature generation
registry.laneP: preserve exact files; transfer definitions only; no v0 estimate promotion

levels.episodes: first episode per symbol/session; no session/lunch crossing response or swings

scale.crossSessionActions: exclude current and prior session around nonunit AdjFactor or nonempty ExRT; no adjusted prices, no claim complete action knowledge
scale.definition: median prior trueRange/priorClose; current excluded; no peer shrink; missing first prior close yields missing TR

statistics.Blook: one fixed A->B measurement; repeated generation equality only; no tune or registry extension afterB
statistics.EB: continuous residual normal-normal prior strength20, posteriorSd from within-session sample variance/nEff; rates Beta-Binomial prior strength20 at logistic peer mean; prior fit A only
statistics.bootstrapP: two-sided centered bootstrap error distribution against zero; fixed family BH denominator all registered scalars
statistics.covariateTick: logPrice proxy only; actual tick table not known and not inferred
statistics.dedup: registry order; if accepted rawA profile absSpearman>=0.8 retain earlier only; no posthoc factors
statistics.liquidityStrata: A logVa tertiles; require incremental>0 in>=2 strata each>=30 symbols
statistics.marketRelative: daily crosssection transformed trait median subtraction; report diagnostic reliability, not extra primary tests
statistics.nEff: n*(1-rho1)/(1+rho1), rho1 clipped[0,0.9], capped n; consecutive session pairs only
statistics.peerFit: OLS A only with intercept, standardized A covariates; no symbol dummies; minimum100 paired symbols
statistics.randomSplit: seeded pooled A+B shuffle24/23; diagnostic only, no adopting random-only trait
statistics.tailSensitivity: exclude top3 sessions by median absolute daily return withinA+B; refit A only; require incremental>=0.15 and raw>=0.30; minimum sessions still20
statistics.transform: rate logit with Jeffreys0.5 smoothing at profile; share clip[1e-4,1-1e-4] logit; correlation clip[-.999,.999] Fisher; positive log; others identity
